title: Thanksgiving Sailing Expedition with Sergio Torres "Canei"

blocks.title: November in the Sea of Cortez, with Sergio Torres.
blocks.lede: Spearfishing, freediving and days at sea with your own people. Private boat, 3 to 7 nights, ending Sunday, November 29.
blocks.imageAlt: Sergio Torres Expedition Leader de Eagle Ray Expeditions Sailing Experience in La Paz

blocks.body:
## WHO IS SERGIO

Survivor México 2025 champion, Ironman and personal trainer.

He has guided groups in several countries and is now an Expedition Leader at Eagle Ray.

On this trip, he shapes the day: when to get in the water, where to fish, and when to do nothing at all.
